description.value: The Columbia is a heritage performance and event venue built in 1927 in downtown New Westminster, BC. Listed as a historic building, it has operated for nearly a century as a community theatre and continues to host live events. A touring cyclist passing through New Westminster's historic downtown core would find it a notable cultural landmark on Columbia Street.
